backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining Chapter and PdfEntry types with full CRUD operations, admin password verification via SHA-256 hash comparison, and in-memory Map storage for both entities.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that updates the actor state by setting the adminPasswordHash to the correct SHA-256 hash value during canister upgrades.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two implemented features: rewriting hashPassword.ts to use SubtleCrypto SHA-256 and auditing AdminAuthGuard.tsx to ensure raw password strings are passed directly to hashPassword.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one- to two-sentence summaries of all frontend source files, describing the purpose and key implementation details of each component, page, hook, and utility.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining CSS custom property design tokens for light and dark themes, including colors for background, foreground, primary, secondary, border, and chart variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Study Sphere Pakistan PWA, linking the manifest, app icon, Google Fonts (Inter and Poppins), and mounting the React app via the root div.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA web app manifest for Study Sphere Pakistan, defining app name, display mode, theme/background colors, orientation, and a single 256x256 icon.
frontend/public/service-worker.js: Service worker implementing a cache-first with network update strategy, pre-caching static assets on install and cleaning up old caches on activate.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application file that configures TanStack Router with all page routes, provides DarkModeProvider and QueryClient context, and manages splash screen display via sessionStorage.
frontend/src/components/AdminAuthGuard.t: A password-protected gate component that wraps admin content, verifying credentials via a hashed password check against the backend actor and persisting auth state in sessionStorage.
frontend/src/components/AudioPlayer.tsx: A custom audio player component with play/pause, seek, and volume controls, handling error and empty URL states with appropriate fallback UI.
frontend/src/components/ChapterCard.tsx: A clickable card component displaying a chapter's title, available content features (notes, audio, quiz, flashcards), and completion status, navigating to the chapter detail page on click.
frontend/src/components/ChapterForm.tsx: A form component for creating or editing a chapter, supporting fields for title, class, subject, URLs, quiz questions, and flashcards, with add/update mutations.
frontend/src/components/ClassPage.tsx: An intentionally empty placeholder file indicating that the ClassPage component lives in the pages directory.
frontend/src/components/FlashcardSection: An interactive flashcard viewer with flip animation, previous/next navigation, and swipe gesture support, showing a fallback UI when no cards are available.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: A site footer component displaying the StudyHub brand, quick navigation links, legal information, and a copyright notice with a caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky navigation header with logo, desktop/mobile nav links, dark mode toggle, and admin icon button using TanStack Router for navigation.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout component that wraps all pages with a Header, Footer, and a flex-column structure using TanStack Router's Outlet.
frontend/src/components/NotesViewer.tsx: Renders an iframe to display notes from a URL (with Google Drive embed support), showing fallback UI when no URL is provided or loading fails.
frontend/src/components/PdfEntryForm.tsx: Form component for adding or editing a PDF entry (title, type, URL) that calls add/update mutations and navigates back on save or cancel.
frontend/src/components/QuizSection.tsx: Interactive multiple-choice quiz component that steps through questions, tracks answers, and displays a scored results screen with a retry option.
frontend/src/components/SplashScreen.tsx: Animated full-screen splash screen shown on app load that auto-dismisses after 2 seconds with a fade-out transition.
frontend/src/contexts/DarkModeContext.ts: React context provider that persists and applies dark mode state to the document root, exposing isDark and toggleDark via a custom hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using TanStack Query, invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication on the ICP platform, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for CRUD operations on chapters and PDF entries, wrapping backend actor calls with caching and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind CSS, CSS custom properties for light/dark themes, and flashcard flip animation styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin panel page protected by an auth guard, providing tabbed UI to list, create, edit, and delete chapters and PDF entries.
frontend/src/pages/ChapterPage.tsx: Detail page for a single chapter that displays audio, quiz, and flashcard tabs, and tracks completion state in local storage.
frontend/src/pages/ClassPage.tsx: Displays a grid of subjects (Biology, Chemistry, Physics, English) for a given class number and navigates to the selected subject's chapter list.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with a hero section, search bar, class/MDCAT navigation buttons, and a feature highlights grid for the study platform.
frontend/src/pages/MDCATPage.tsx: MDCAT preparation hub page showing subject navigation cards and a list of past papers/practice tests fetched from the backend, with add and delete functionality.
frontend/src/pages/MDCATSubjectPage.tsx: Displays chapters for a specific MDCAT subject with search, recently viewed tracking, and delete support, filtering backend chapters by class 'MDCAT' and subject slug.
frontend/src/pages/SubjectPage.tsx: Lists chapters for a given class number and subject with search filtering, recently viewed history, and chapter delete functionality using backend data.
frontend/src/pages/SupportPage.tsx: Donation/support page displaying an Easypaisa account number with a copy-to-clipboard button and step-by-step instructions for sending money.
frontend/src/pages/TermsPage.tsx: Renders the Terms & Conditions page with five static policy sections (educational use, no board affiliation, content changes, external links, copyright) and navigation back to home or support.
frontend/src/types/chapter.ts: Defines canonical frontend TypeScript interfaces for Chapter, PdfEntry, QuizQuestion, and FlashcardItem used throughout the UI.
frontend/src/utils/chapterMapper.ts: Provides mapper functions to convert backend Motoko Chapter and PdfEntry types (bigint IDs, JSON strings) into frontend types (string IDs, parsed arrays).
frontend/src/utils/hashPassword.ts: Exports a single async function that hashes a password string using SHA-256 via the Web Crypto API and returns a lowercase hex string.
frontend/src/utils/jsonValidation.ts: Exports validation functions for quiz and flashcard JSON strings, enforcing required fields and types, along with example JSON constants for each format.
frontend/src/utils/storageService.ts: Manages device-local user data in localStorage: recently viewed chapter IDs, completed chapter tracking, and dark mode preference.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the theme with CSS-variable-based color tokens, Inter/Poppins fonts, custom border radii, and accordion/fade-in/pulse-ring animations.
project_state.json: Tracks the overall project state (version 21) for Study Sphere Pakistan, documenting architecture, existing features, and a known issue with the admin password SHA-256 hash mismatch.
